# Copilot instructions

- Keep edits narrowly scoped to the requested profile/README change.
- Read only the files needed for the task; do not explore unrelated repositories or account data.
- Preserve existing profile structure and links unless the task explicitly changes them.
- Avoid repeated rewrites, broad cleanup, or speculative additions.
- Do not use GitHub Actions as a debugging loop.
- Stop when the requested profile update is complete and internally consistent.
